### PiliBabel v1.10.3

**The extra title lines now actually fit.**

- Raising the title to four lines was not enough on its own: the card block has a fixed
  height, so the third and fourth lines were being clipped and only a sliver of the third
  line was visible - worse than before. The block is now genuinely taller: the title area
  grows by 38px in every cover grid (home recommendations, member pages, rankings, live
  lists, search) when the option is on.
- Comments can also be expanded by default now, from Settings - Other.

Downloads are below.
